query:
INSERT INTO molecules_recettes (molecule_id, recette_id, proportion, notes) 
SELECT m.id, r.id, 0.05, 'Pheromone steroidienne - dose infinitesimale pour effet subliminal'
FROM molecules m, recettes r 
WHERE m.name LIKE '%Androst%' AND r.name LIKE '%Pheromona%'
LIMIT 1
